card.name: Names starting with Da/De/Du
card.fires_on: The name Dante, or the early part of a person or place name beginning with D (Dam-, Dub-, Dev-, Dew-, Don-). It fires when the name has just begun and more letters follow.

modes.label: Dante as a name
modes.description: The first name Dante, for a person or the poet, right before a surname or possessive.
modes.example: “Six years sets the whole cadence for our mission,” said<< Dante>> Lauretta of the University of Arizona

modes.label: Partway through D names
modes.description: A middle piece of a longer D-name, such as a first name, a place or a drug name.

card.plain: It lights up on names that start with D, such as Dante, Damian or Dublin, before the name is finished.
